one_liner: Telegram offers a free Bot API (token from @BotFather) plus MTProto user API (api_id/api_hash); easily buildable, with only community MCP servers.
auth_notes: Bot API uses a static bot token from @BotFather. MTProto user API uses api_id/api_hash plus phone-code login (session auth). Telegram Login offers OIDC authorization-code with PKCE, but only for sign-in, not for the main API.
access_notes: The Bot API and the Telegram API (MTProto) are free. A bot token comes from @BotFather, and api_id/api_hash come from my.telegram.org.
blocker_notes: The Bot API docs page was not in the evidence. The REST, broad and webhooks labels rely on the policies page, which describes a simple HTTPS interface, and on general knowledge. Bots cannot act as a user account, and user-level access needs MTProto sessions.

evidence.quote: You will get basic addresses as well as the **api_id** and **api_hash** parameters required for user authorization.
Our implementation follows the standard [Authorization Code Flow](https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html#CodeFlowAuth) with **PKCE** support.
| Bot API | Bots and Mini Apps: messages, buttons, payments, groups, channels | A token from @BotFather | Free |
